purpose: Test the explanation that the full montage decodes the next day worse because, with a few hundred training trials, its extra low-information electrodes let the network fit patterns that do not carry over: less data, noise or shuffled signals in place of the dropped electrodes, channel dropout, and held-out runs of the training day against the next day.
claim_boundary: Exploratory for BCI IV 2a: planned after its 16-versus-22 test result was known, which motivated it. For Lee2019 the predictions and tests were fixed in this plan before any model of the new conditions was scored on Lee2019 session 2, but Lee2019's own full-62 and relevance-45 test results were already known from the replication study. Four predictions, no correction for multiplicity. It explains a result; it does not change the frozen 2a configuration.

P1.claim: Less training data widens the full montage's deficit
P1.contrast: (reduced minus full) of models trained on part of the training day minus (reduced minus full) of models trained on all of it, both scored on the next day. Lee2019: fold models (one run, 100 trials) against final models (both runs). BCI IV 2a: fold (4 runs) and rfold (2 runs) against final (6 runs)

P2.claim: The deficit also appears on held-out trials of the training day, not only on the next day
P2.contrast: reduced minus full on the held-out run(s) of the training day, fold models

P3.claim: Inputs that carry nothing hurt: noise in place of the dropped electrodes lowers accuracy

P4.claim: Channel dropout helps the full montage more than the reduced one
P4.contrast: (full-chdrop minus full) minus (reduced-chdrop minus reduced), next day

descriptive: reduced-plus-shuffled minus reduced, and minus full (real EEG that is unrelated to the trial)
full-chdrop minus reduced (does regularization make dropping electrodes unnecessary?)
(reduced minus full) on the next day minus (reduced minus full) within the training day, same fold models
training-set accuracy, held-out accuracy within the day and next-day accuracy of full and reduced
every contrast for BCI IV 2a, with the seed error of each mean (2a has ten seeds)
analysis: seeds averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a scored on artifact-free session-2 trials (the frozen primary analysis), Lee2019 on all session-2 trials
noise: white Gaussian noise through the preprocessing band-pass (causal 4th-order Butterworth 4-38 Hz at 250 Hz, 2-s warm-up), unit variance, drawn once per dataset, participant and day (mibci.overfit)
shuffled: the dropped electrodes of each trial copied from another trial of the same day, a fixed derangement per dataset, participant and day (mibci.overfit)
reduced_montage: BCI IV 2a relevance-16 (archived final rankings); Lee2019 relevance-45 (replication plan); fold models: relevance order of the fold's own training runs
